feature: D3 judge fallback for empty JIRA descriptions
problem: When a JIRA issue has no description (empty or None), _score_d3_diagnosis() returns score=0.0 immediately with 'JIRA issue has no description'. This creates a systematic bias — commits where JIRA has no description (e.g. f897d46870ba) are penalized with D3=0 regardless of agent reasoning quality. The fix diff contains the actual root cause signal and should serve as fallback oracle.
proposed_solution: In eval_judge.py: add D3_FIX_DIFF_FALLBACK_RUBRIC (uses fix diff as oracle instead of JIRA description) and score_d3_root_cause_fix_diff_fallback() method. In eval_harness.py: when jira_issue.description is empty AND fix_files are available, route through fix-diff fallback instead of returning 0. Add judge_oracle metadata tag ('jira' | 'fix-diff-fallback') to the DimensionScore details string. Unit tests + docs/evaluation.md.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: eval_judge.py has D3_FIX_DIFF_FALLBACK_RUBRIC + score_d3_root_cause_fix_diff_fallback() that uses fix diff as oracle
AC-2: eval_harness._score_d3_diagnosis() routes to fix-diff fallback when description is empty AND fix_files available
AC-3: DimensionScore details includes judge_oracle=jira or judge_oracle=fix-diff-fallback tag
AC-4: Valid-JIRA-description commits still use standard D3 JIRA path (no regression)
AC-5: Unit tests cover: (a) empty description + fix files → fallback used, (b) non-empty description → standard path, (c) empty description + no fix files → score=0
AC-6: docs/evaluation.md documents the fallback behavior
edge_cases: EC-1: description is None (not empty string) → treated as empty → fallback
EC-2: description is empty string '' → treated as empty → fallback
EC-3: fix_files is empty set → no fallback available → score=0 with informative message
verification_method: pytest tests/test_eval_judge.py -v; check details strings contain judge_oracle tag
